label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from request.getParameter() reaches response.getWriter().println() via string concatenation. The replace("\"", """) only escapes quotes but does not prevent script tags, event handlers (onerror=, onclick=), or other XSS vectors. Attackers can still inject malicious content like which executes despite quote escaping.

evidence.note: User input flows directly to response.getWriter().println() with only weak quote escaping
